name: Spawn Point
tagline: You just landed on a raw planet. Before you can survive it, you need to learn how to think, find your way, and figure out what this place is made of.
unitIntro: Unit 1: Spawn Point. You just landed on a raw planet. Before you can survive it, you need to learn how to think, find your way, and figure out what this place is made of.
description: You just woke up on a strange planet. Grab a map, switch on your science brain, and figure out what this world is made of.

name: The Mine
tagline: Time to grab a pickaxe. Every tool, every building, every phone starts with something dug out of the ground. Let's find out what's down there.
unitIntro: Unit 2: The Mine. Time to grab a pickaxe. Every tool, every building, every phone starts with something dug out of the ground. Let's find out what's down there.
description: Grab a pickaxe. Every phone, every building, every tool starts with something dug out of the ground. Learn what's down there and how it got there.

name: The Surface
tagline: You've survived underground. Now step outside, where wind, water, ice, and gravity are slowly tearing the whole place apart.
unitIntro: Unit 3: The Surface. You've survived underground. Now step outside, where wind, water, ice, and gravity are slowly tearing the whole place apart.
description: Step outside. Wind, water, ice, and gravity are slowly tearing the whole place apart. Find water, read the land, and don't stand under that hill.

name: The Deep
tagline: Below the surface is a whole world of heat, pressure, and moving rock. This is where earthquakes, volcanoes, and mountains come from.
unitIntro: Unit 4: The Deep. Below the surface is a whole world of heat, pressure, and moving rock. This is where earthquakes, volcanoes, and mountains come from.
description: Dig past the crust into heat, pressure, and moving rock. This is where earthquakes, volcanoes, and mountains are born, and eastern Idaho sits right on top of the action.

name: The Ocean
tagline: Over 70% of the planet is covered in water, and we've explored less of the deep sea than the surface of Mars. Time to dive in.
unitIntro: Unit 5: The Ocean. Over 70% of the planet is covered in water, and we've explored less of the deep sea than the surface of Mars. Time to dive in.
description: Over 70% of the planet is water, and most of it is unexplored. Ride the currents, map the sea floor, and find life that never sees the Sun.

name: The Sky
tagline: Look up. That thin blue layer is the only thing standing between you and the cold, deadly vacuum of space. Let's see how it works.
unitIntro: Unit 6: The Sky. Look up. That thin blue layer is the only thing standing between you and the cold, deadly vacuum of space. Let's see how it works.
description: That thin blue layer is all that stands between you and space. Learn to read the clouds, survive the storms, and understand a changing climate.

name: Ancient Layers
tagline: The rocks under your feet are a history book billions of years long. Time to learn how to read it.
unitIntro: Unit 7: Ancient Layers. The rocks under your feet are a history book billions of years long. Time to learn how to read it.
description: The rocks under your feet are a history book 4.6 billion years long. Dig up fossils, crack the code of time, and meet Idaho's ancient horses and dinosaurs.

name: Resources
tagline: Every survival game is about gathering resources. So is real life. Here's where our stuff comes from, and what it costs.
unitIntro: Unit 8: Resources. Every survival game is about gathering resources. So is real life. Here's where our stuff comes from, and what it costs.
description: Every survivor needs supplies. Find the planet's energy, water, and minerals, and figure out how to use them without wrecking the base.

name: Beyond Bedrock
tagline: You've dug to the core and survived the surface. Now look up. The final frontier starts with our nearest neighbors.
unitIntro: Unit 9: Beyond Bedrock. You've dug to the core and survived the surface. Now look up. The final frontier starts with our nearest neighbors.
description: You've explored the whole planet. Now look up. The Moon, the Sun, the planets, and 2 trillion galaxies are waiting.
